items.title: I'm making LLMs work on small and old devices

extra.evidence: maxxing the ability to run different LLMs on the smallest devices possible - hyperionaidev/smolmaxxing Run the biggest language model you can on the smallest hardware you own. TV boxes, old tablets, single-board computers and routers all have a CPU, some RAM and flash storage that sit idle most of the day. smolmaxxing finds the biggest model each of them can really run, then pushes it further with custom kernels, careful memory use and weights streamed from flash. Every number in this repo was measured on the device itself. Both devices run 8B and 16B mixture-of-experts models on about 1 GB of RAM by keeping only part of each model in memory and reading the rest from flash as it's needed. More devices (phones, single-board computers, routers) are coming. The techniques aren't tied to one…

items.title: 姚期智杨植麟首次联手给 AI 出的博士级题目，Kimi 多画出了「关键一条边」
items.summary: Kimi 刷新 629 条边图论参考纪录，只多加了1条边，为什么数学界等了这么多年？ 作者丨 郑佳美 编辑丨岑 峰 给 124 个点连线，不能出现三角形，也不能出现四边形。此前的参考记录是 629 条——数学界认为这已经接近极限。而Kimi K3 构造出了 630 条边的图，并通过程序验证。 多1条边，听起来不多。但在组合数学里，你每试图多塞进一条边，都需要在全图 124 个点之间重新完成一次精密的结构大重构。这1条边意味着AI第一次在“极值构造”这类研究级任务上，把人类参考纪录往前推了一步。 这项成果来自图灵奖得主、中科院院士、清华大学交叉信息研究院院长姚期智与月之暗面创始人杨植麟等人的联合研究。他们真正想回答的问题是： AI到底能不能做数学研究，而不只是做数学题？ 01 「多 1 条边」算不算真突破？ 姚期智，图灵奖得主、清华大学交叉信息研究院院长，是中国理论计算机科学的奠基者之一；杨植麟，月之暗面创始人，Kimi背后的推动者。 两代人、两种身份：一位是理论计算机科学的泰斗，一位是大模型创业的一线操盘手，第一次联合署名。 这个组合本身就说明了一件事：AI做科研，已经不是“实验室里…

items.title: 多模态“源神”！MiniMax开源SOTA生图模型，原生4K，一张两毛

extra.evidence: 「CAD拆解」 继开源视频旗舰H3广受好评后，最新的图像模型—— H3-Image，再次席卷全网 。 热度最高的是「CAD拆解」，丢一张参考图，H3-Image能给你小手办直接开盒了。。。 除此之外，海外网友测下来，其他类型的复杂生图任务也是能Handle住的，比如—— 游戏 。 过去我们一提到AI生图，脑子里第一个反应：油光满面，皮肤光滑得像剥了壳的鸡蛋，眼神呆滞，伪人感极重。 此外，像镜子上的水泽和灰尘，闪光灯打在镜头上形成的光晕，这些细节也处理得非常离谱，真就跟小某书首页刷到的一样。 即便从仰视角度也能看出不少面部细节，就比如下面这张 桌子即ins照片 的时尚杂志封面，你仔细看人物的眼神，和微妙的面部肌肉牵引，都是非常符合现实社交逻辑的。 这也是我测H3-Image时最大的一个感受，很多我丢给老模型做过的提示词，H3-Image都能给出全新诠释。 放大看根本不会露馅，手指上的皮肤纹理、关节褶皱，甚至指甲边缘的自然光泽与质感，都还原得一清二楚。 我觉得，H3-Image之所以AI味这么少，可能很大程度上就取决于这些 刻意为之的「瑕疵」 。 任何人类主观创造的作品，必然充斥着随机性，过分追求完美反而不符合人类大脑接收信息的习惯。 现在看来，似乎只要能把其中的Trick摸清楚，很多人类引以为傲的品质，可能真的没那么神秘…… 让H3-Image画个机械拆解的爆炸图，它能精准遵循机械的装配逻辑，把零件给你分层清晰地炸开，甚至连组件引线都给你标上。 当然，对于这类功能属性明显的图片，指令遵循能力也是非常重要的， 光「画」其实难度不是很大 ，主要是考验模型规划、推理的能力。 当然了，真要打严肃生产力场景的话，标准肯定是要拉很高的，商业用途必须准确传达信息。 凭借鄙人勉强结业的高数知识储备，我大概看了一下，发现答案居然是对的，还有解题步骤！？？ 现在不是流行Coding吃掉一切吗，…

items.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
items.summary: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.
items.summary_zh: 为了解决数学监督数据缺乏结构化组织的问题，该论文提出了TOME-Math数据集，将大学数学教材转化为约38万条结构化证明监督记录。实验表明，基于该数据集微调的模型在基准测试中平均得分提升了16.7个百分点。

items.title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.
items.title_zh: REAL Loss：优化推理加速的期望接受长度
items.summary_zh: 针对推测解码中期望接受长度（EAL）优化不精确的问题，该论文提出了REAL损失函数，通过路径权重和无偏估计来直接优化EAL。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B目标模型和Domino起草者的对比中，REAL在多个任务子集上优于其他基线方法。

items.title: BioXArena-Pro: a research-grade benchmark for autonomous biomedical machine learning agents
items.summary: Coding agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous builders of biomedical models, but existing benchmarks are small, near saturation or open to leaked information. We present BioXArena-Pro, 64 research-level modelling tasks from eight biomedical domains, each rebuilt from a published study; most hold out whole biological units such as species or cohorts. Across 22 agent configurations, the best scores 55.1 of 100, and the scaffold matters almost as much as the model. We re-ran a published method for every task: where the published recipe applies unchanged, the best agent and the methods tie; on rebuilt tasks the methods trail by 8.2 points, suggesting that agents gain by adapting to new data. Pretrained models (including biological foundation models) matter where the strongest agent uses them: forbidding them decreases its score on those tasks by 9 points. Every task was audited in several AI-assisted rounds and a final human review.

items.title: OpticalRAG: Pixel-Space Compression for Token-Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is bottlenecked by the token budget of large language models: feeding long documents into the context window is expensive, while aggressive textual compression discards fine-grained information that is irreversibly lost in a one-dimensional token sequence. We argue that this bottleneck is not fundamental to information density but to the choice of compression \emph{modality}. Modern visual encoders can pack the contents of a rendered text page into roughly a hundred visual tokens with little semantic loss, opening a new compression-fidelity tradeoff that purely textual methods cannot reach. We present \textbf{OpticalRAG}, a framework that renders documents as page images, encodes them with a frozen vision encoder, and distills the retrieved visual tokens into as few as $16$ injected tokens before passing them to the LLM. Two ingredients make this work without expensive cross-modal training: (i) \emph{Encoder-Bridged Retrieval}, which projects text-query states into the visual feature space of the frozen encoder, through a projection shared with the compressor, to retrieve visual tokens from a text query, with no contrastive training; and (ii) \emph{Query-Driven Distillation}, a lightweight cross-attention compressor that condenses the retrieved visual tokens into a small set of query-conditioned prefix tokens. On LongBench-v2, BAMBOO, and LooGLE-v2, OpticalRAG achieves the best compression-aware accuracy (CAP) on all three benchmarks whil…

items.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
items.summary: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Correcting these behavioral divergences remains difficult: offline data may miss the student's failure contexts, while its own rollouts may provide few correct responses in those contexts. We introduce SteerDistill, a quantization-aware distillation method in which a full-precision teacher guides the student to revise failed responses and iteratively refines its guidance using feedback from student execution. This closed-loop teacher steering produces locally verified behavioral corrections. We internalize these corrections by training the student without guidance to match the steered student's predictions at corrected turns and the full-precision teacher's at other turns, enabling unassisted inference. Across five agentic benchmarks and three models, SteerDistill exceeds the strongest quantized baseline by 1.67--2.18 points in average score under W4A16 and stays within one point of BF16. On $τ^2$-Bench, it outperforms QeRL by 1.84 percentage points in success rate using 67% fewer training GPU hours and produces shorter successful trajectories than the quantized baselines.

items.summary_zh: 为了解决低比特量化导致智能体任务成功率下降的问题，该论文提出了SteerDistill方法，通过全精度教师引导量化学生修正失败响应。实验表明，该方法在保持高准确率的同时，显著减少了训练GPU使用时间并生成了更短的成功轨迹。

6fb33fd6ca16.headline: OpticalRAG：基于像素空间的检索增强生成
6fb33fd6ca16.body: 论文提出了OpticalRAG框架，通过视觉编码器将文档渲染为图像并压缩为少量注入令牌。该方法在保持高压缩感知准确率的同时降低了计算开销。

0073617c1eb1.body: 论文提出了SteerDistill方法，通过全精度教师引导量化学生修正失败响应。该方法在保持高准确率的同时减少了训练GPU使用时间。
